title: Kecksburg crash witnesses saw people in moon suits

tellings.quote: know, if you think back to the 1965 Kexsburg, Pennsylvania crash, all the witnesses on on SE scene said they saw people in what they called moon suits

plain: When something crashed near Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, in 1965, all the witnesses at the scene are said to have seen people in what they called moon suits. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells Michels this without naming a source. He tells it as a sign that a trained team was ready to recover crashed objects.
